address: The Grand, 90 Federal Street, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: Aotearoa Chef Michael Meredith explores his Samoan heritage in a restaurant he named after his mother, as it was her cooking which first inspired him to become a chef. The colours and textures of the room hint at oceans and islands, while the open kitchen at one end adds extra energy. Start with panikeke – a Samoan fried doughnut; wood-fired dishes, like snapper or duck breast, are standouts; and if you go for the crispy pork hock with sapa sui then you’ll certainly need some friends to help you finish it.
